name: lokiplay
description: Command-line tools for Loki game projects and deployments. Loki hosts finished web JavaScript games. Support for Unity, Godot, iOS, and Android are coming soon.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && node ../../scripts/sync-agent-instructions.mjs && tsc -b --force && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('src/AGENTS.template.md','dist/AGENTS.template.md')" && node ../../scripts/rewrite-package-imports.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/build-hosted-sdk.mjs --out dist/hosted-sdk.js
